rationale: C10 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. It presents the same St. Lawrence project decision as a choice between construction by Canada alone and joint Canadian-American participation, emphasizes the project's national-security value, urges prompt action, and identifies the Federal Power Commission as part of the alternative machinery. The child compresses this framework into numbered National Security Council findings and a brief statement of approved next steps. C21 and C23 share substantial subject matter and advocacy language, but C10 most closely matches the child's distinctive Canada-alone-or-joint alternatives and administrative mechanism.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The United States should promptly take whatever action may be appropriate to clear the way for commencement of the project, whether by Canada alone, or ... by Canada and the United States jointly.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the seaway will be built by the Canadian Government ... [or] the United States would participate equally with Canada in the management and control of the seaway
shared_material.explanation: Both frame the immediate policy choice as Canadian construction alone versus joint United States-Canadian participation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Early initiation and completion of the Saint Lawrence-Great Lakes Seaway is in the interest of national security.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Every top official—civilian and military—with responsibilities for the defense of our country has testified that the St. Lawrence project is of exceptional and direct value to our security.
shared_material.explanation: The child recasts C10's security justification as a formal National Security Council finding.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am forwarding a copy of this letter to the Chairman of the Federal Power Commission for his information and such action as he may deem appropriate.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the power phase of the project will be built by ... a United States entity authorized by the Congress or by the Federal Power Commission
shared_material.explanation: Both connect the alternative route for proceeding with the project to Federal Power Commission authority or action.
